business_scope.primary_industry_name: Income-Generating Real Estate Property Portfolio Trust (REIT)

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Egypt (National Level, Arab Republic of Egypt)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil Law with Islamic Sharia principles influencing commercial and financial matters, and residual common-law influences in certain economic zones)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between the Government of the Arab Republic of Egypt and the Government of [Investor State] for the Promotion and Reciprocal Protection of Investments (BITs network)
Treaty for the Promotion and Protection of Investments between Egypt and the United States (if investor protected)
Egypt-EU Association Agreement (trade and investment liberalization)
Egypt-COMESA Double Taxation Agreement and COMESA Treaty
Bilateral Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (DTAAs) with over 50 states, including Germany, United Kingdom, France, and China

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 8 of 2022 on the Regulation of Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (amending and replacing portions of Law No. 80 of 2002), as implemented by the Executive Regulations issued by Decree of the Council of Ministers; Cabinet Decree No. 2245 of 2023 announcing the establishment of the Unified Economic Registry and the Beneficial Owner Registration System; Law No. 159 of 1981 on Companies (where applicable to LLCs), as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018; the Unified Tax Law (Law No. 91 of 2005). Mandatory beneficial ownership verification pursuant to AML/CFT Executive Regulations and instructions from the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMLCU).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation Charter / Articles of Association (Contrato / Memorandum of Association of the LLC)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney for Pre-Incorporation and Registration (uncertified until legalized)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Clearance Certificate for Criminal Records / Police Clearance for identified UBOs and managers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Relevant police authority or ministry of interior in the country of nationality

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: National ID or Passport of UBOs and officers
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National civil registry or passport issuing authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copy notarized then Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter confirming good standing of investors and financial capacity

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence and risk rating for all prospective UBOs, directors, and managers. Required screening against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the EMLCU local terrorist financing watchlist, and any state-specific sanctions issued by the Egyptian government. The Legal Compliance Officer shall maintain a checklist under the Executive Regulations of the AML Law requiring verification of source of funds, source of wealth, customer identification documents, and ongoing transaction monitoring. PEPs (foreign, domestic, and international organization persons) are subject to enhanced review. Sanctions checks on all UBOs must be refreshed within 7 days prior to incorporation filing, and ongoing monitoring is required after formation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Egyptian Unified Economic Registry Portal (General Authority of Unified Registration, affiliated with the Ministry of Justice) and the Commercial Registry General Authority portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Arabic for primary registration, with a transliterated Latin-script name. Arabic names must respect Islamic and public order standards. The Arabic name should reflect the entity type, and Latin script is only an official transliteration. Use of English or other letters is permitted as a secondary name but the Arabic legal name is the authoritative name. The name must not be misleading as to the entity's licensed purpose, and must follow principles of uniqueness in the Commercial Registry database.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Commercial Registry rejects the proposed name, the applicant or a powers-of-attorney holder filed with the registry may, within fifteen (15) days of notification, submit a written administrative appeal with supplemental evidence to the competent Commercial Registration Committee under the Ministry of International Co-operation / Commercial Registry Authority (follow applicable procedural rules). The appeal must specify the legal basis of the rejection, include a list of alternative candidates, and attach any trademark or trade name opposition evidence. The Committee shall issue a decision within 30 days. If denied, the applicant may instigate administrative court review before the relevant Cairo Administrative Court, with all legal submissions duly notarized.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are generally not acceptable as the statutory address for real estate investment trust management and trust-level corporate registration. The LLC must maintain a physical registered office in Egypt; the exact prerequisite imposes a lease with an address suitable for service of process and the supervision of the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA). Virtual office could only support secondary correspondence, not the registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate to High: estimated 60-80% likelihood of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first 24 months because the entity is a REIT/licensed non-banking financial activity under the supervision of the FRA and the Economic/General Registry. Inspections may be triggered by licensing, UBO verification site visits, or anti-money-laundering controls. The registered office must be physically staffed and must maintain original books and supporting documentation.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Laws No. 4 of 2009 and No. 94 of 2022), Articles 1-3, 21-25; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, Article 10 and its Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 2310 of 2017); Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Investor Services Center (One-Stop Shop), in coordination with the Commercial Registry and the Ministry of Justice Notary Public.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Association / Incorporation Contract executed in Arabic, notarized before a licensed notary public, and filed electronically with GAFI for issuance of the incorporation certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to LLC formation under Law No. 159 of 1981; however, the capital stated in the Articles must be fully subscribed at formation. For REIT portfolio activities, the Financial Regulatory Authority requires a minimum paid-up capital of EGP 10 million (approximately USD 200,000) evidenced by a bank capital-deposit certificate issued after escrow deposit in a licensed Egyptian bank.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, in accordance with the Company's Articles of Association: (1) The statutory incorporation filing before the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones is hereby approved, and the registered office of the Company shall be established at the address stated in the Articles. (2) The subscription and allotment of the initial share capital as recorded in the share register are ratified and deemed fully subscribed. (3) The Corporate Officer appointments are hereby made: Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and Company Secretary, each authorized to act jointly or severally in opening bank accounts and completing regulatory filings. (4) The Company Seal shall be adopted, and all other ancillary corporate governance instruments are approved effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop - Name Reservation Window (online portal: www.gafi.gov.eg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the name reservation application listing three alternative company names; pay the prescribed non-refundable reservation fee; obtain the Name Reservation Certificate valid for sixty (60) days. The Arabic trade name must not contravene public order or misrepresent the REIT activity.
required_dossiers: Completed name reservation application form
Copy of national ID or passport of each incorporator
Cover letter stating the intended business scope (ISIC 6499 - real estate investment trust)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for conflict or misleading wording, counsel may file a revised list of alternative names within five (5) business days without additional registration service fees; the reservation date is preserved upon the first valid filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Temporary Bank Account and Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A licensed commercial bank in Egypt (e.g., National Bank of Egypt or Commercial International Bank)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary subscription bank account in the company's name; deposit the subscribed share capital and any agreed share premium; obtain a bank-issued Capital Deposit Certificate indicating the balance, currency, and accountholder, which will accompany the incorporation application to GAFI.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association
GAFI name reservation certificate
Valid identification of authorized signatories
Board/incorporator resolution authorizing the account opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank's compliance unit requests source-of-funds evidence, provide bank statements or tax receipts; rejections may be cured by re-designating an authorized signatory and re-filing the same banking package without restarting the name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization of the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Justice - Notary Public Office (Shahr Al-Tawqee'), Cairo or competent governorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the final Arabic Articles of Association with accurate pagination, together with all incorporators' identity documents; all incorporators or their authorized attorneys must personally attest their signatures before the notary; pay the attestation fee; obtain the notarized instrument evidencing legal formation intent.
required_dossiers: Final Arabic Articles of Association (two original copies)
GAFI name reservation certificate
National ID/passport of each incorporator
Power of attorney for each authorized signatory (if executed by attorney, on Ministry of Justice form)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises legal objections (e.g., defective capital clause or conflicting objects), counsel shall revise the Articles and re-submit for attestation; additional notarial fees may apply but no new name reservation is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Application Filing with GAFI One-Stop Shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI - Investor Services Center (One-Stop Shop), Cairo headquarters or governorate branch
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete incorporation set through the GAFI One-Stop Shop, including the notarized Articles, capital deposit certificate, and statutory declaration forms; the OSS desk shall issue a receipt acknowledgment, initiate company registration with the Commercial Registry, and issue the Incorporation Certificate (Certificate of Company Formation) within the statutory processing window.
required_dossiers: Notarized Articles of Association
Bank capital deposit certificate (or exemption statement if no capital deposit rule applies)
GAFI incorporation application form (Form 1) and economic activity declaration
Copies of valid identification of incorporators and managers
Written consents of the appointed managers to act as officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: GAFI may issue a deficiency notice requiring corrections; the applicant has thirty (30) calendar days to cure the deficiencies, failing which the file is deemed withdrawn. Counsel shall respond in writing via the OSS case-track system and, if needed, amend the Articles and re-attest the revised pages.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Registration and Issuance of Commercial Registration Number
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Office (Ministry of Interior) integrated with GAFI OSS
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the incorporation certificate, the OSS desk registers the LLC in the Commercial Registry; verify the commercial registration extract displays the legal form, capital, managers, and REIT object; collect the Commercial Registration Certificate and the tax registration preparatory documents.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation certificate
Notarized Articles of Association
Incorporators' identification records
Completed commercial registration statutory form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commercial Registry queries the business object or manager eligibility, submit a rectification form signed by the managers and the GAFI-issued certificate; registry corrections are executed within one (1) business day of lawful proof.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Card and Corporate Tax Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) - Taxpayer Services Center
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the statutory tax registration forms to obtain the corporate tax card (noting corporate tax rate of 22.5% under Law No. 91 of 2005 as amended) and the VAT registration certificate (14% standard rate) for the REIT's management and leasing services; complete the ETA data file and request issuance of the consolidated tax card.
required_dossiers: Commercial registration certificate
Notarized Articles of Association and incorporation certificate
Copy of lease title or registered office proof
National ID/passport and tax cards of managers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ETA rejects the file for incomplete lead declarations, supply the missing bank or lease records within ten (10) business days; the tax card is retroactive to the date of initial submission if the cure is timely.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Insurance Registration of the Company and Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) - local insurance office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the LLC as an employer and register the named officers and any employees on Form 1 and Form 2 within the statutory 60-day period following commercial registration; obtain the social insurance account number used for payroll compliance.
required_dossiers: Commercial registration extract
Notarized Articles of Association
National ID of each officer and employee
Employment contracts or officer appointment decisions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NOSI imposes late-registration fines, appeal administratively with a timeline proof of incorporation; once registration is effected, the account record is backdated and penalty reversal is requested in writing to the insurance office director.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Financial Regulatory Authority REIT Licensing and Product Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) - Non-Banking Financial Services Sector, Real Estate Finance and Investment Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the REIT formation application covering the trust deed, fund prospectus, core portfolio identification, and the corporate governance manual; pay the FRA fee; obtain the FRA Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Operating License authorizing portfolio acquisition, leasing, and income distribution before commencing operations.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation certificate and Articles of Association
REIT trust deed and management agreement
Fund prospectus and investment policy in Arabic
Independent property valuation report for the initial portfolio
Compliance and AML/CFT program (including AML Law No. 80 of 2002 compliance)
Declaration of fitness for the CEO, CFO, and compliance officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The FRA may serve a supplementary-remarks memo; the applicant has thirty (30) calendar days to cure with amended documents, after which the FRA must issue either approval or a reasoned rejection; administrative appeal may be lodged with the FRA Board and judicial annulment is available before the State Council.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental Screening Registration and Municipal Operating Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) - regional branch, and the municipality (local administration unit)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the REIT as a non-industrial activity with the EEAA environmental registry; obtain the environmental screening confirmation and proceed with the municipality to secure the operating permit and occupancy certificate for the registered office and any physically held commercial premises.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation certificate and commercial registration extract
Standard EEAA environmental registration questionnaire (Category C)
Site title or lease contract for the registered office
Occupancy and structural inspection certificate (Unified Building Law No. 119 of 2008)
Civil defense fire safety certificate for each occupied floor space
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the EEAA reclassifies the activity to Category B requiring an environmental baseline report, commission the report from a licensed environmental consultant and file within the EEAA-determined grace period; municipal clearance objections are cured by supplementary building safety documentation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) - Non-Banking Financial Services Sector, Real Estate Investment Regulation Department
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Operating License and Product Registration, applied under Capital Market Law No. 95 of 1992 (as amended by Law No. 17 of 2018) and FRA Board Decree No. 18 of 2020 on Real Estate Investment Funds.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) - Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C - Environmental Screening Registration only (no Full EIA Report or detailed baseline study required for an asset-holding REIT with no industrial manufacturing, waste, or discharge processes; applicability limited to registered office and commercial premises)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or industrial VOC emission sources attributable to the REIT; compliance with Law No. 4 of 1994 on Environment Protection and its Executive Regulations (Decree No. 338 of 1995) for any HVAC or standby-generator emissions; non-hazardous solid waste must be transferred via licensed waste contractors; direct-held properties must undergo a Phase I environmental due diligence to characterize pre-existing contamination before acquisition into the trust portfolio.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety approval certificate for all owned and managed office premises issued by the General Administration of Civil Defense (Ministry of Interior) before occupancy; structural load and safety inspection certificate under the Unified Building Law No. 119 of 2008 and its executive regulations; occupational health and workplace clearance under Article 208 of Labor Law No. 12 of 2003 confirming proper ventilation, lighting, and egress.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance; taxpayer portal and e-invoice clearance platform at https://tax.gov.eg and https://einvoice.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Egyptian LLC must first incorporate with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), obtain commercial registration, and then apply to the ETA for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and the tax card (binding tax card). The application is filed through the ETA taxpayer portal or at the competent tax office and requires: certificate of incorporation and Memorandum of Association, commercial registration certificate, notarized board resolution appointing the local tax representative, specimen of authorized signatories, proof of registered office, opening bank certificate, and for non-resident shareholders a tax residency certificate or adequate legalized documentation. The TIN/tax card must be obtained before commencing activity or within statutory registration deadlines. VAT registration with the ETA is mandatory once taxable supplies exceed the annual threshold; the LLC must submit the ETA Form for VAT registration and receive a VAT certificate number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or general passthrough election exists under Egyptian tax law. An Egyptian LLC is a resident juridical person taxed at the corporate level on worldwide income under Income Tax Law No. 91/2005. There is no statutory REIT passthrough election; a real estate investment trust operating as an LLC remains subject to corporate income tax. Taxpayers may elect the fiscal year and certain depreciation and inventory methods subject to ETA approval, and may elect grouped VAT registration with related taxable persons in limited circumstances. Egypt does not provide hybrid mismatch elections domestically; relief is only by treaty tie-breaker provisions where applicable.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016 as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 1,000,000 annual taxable turnover for mandatory VAT registration; voluntary registration is available where annual turnover exceeds EGP 500,000
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt enforces mandatory e-invoicing and e-receipt filing through the ETA. VAT-registered businesses must issue real-time electronic invoices using ETA-certified APIs or the taxpayer portal. Every invoice/tax invoice must be submitted to the ETA clearance engine before delivery to the buyer, and a QR code and digital unique identifier must be embedded on the invoice. The e-invoice system requires structured XML with ETA-validated code; discrepancies trigger automatic rejection and blocking of the transaction read. Businesses above the threshold must integrate their accounting/ERP systems with the ETA API or use the ETA web portal. Penalties apply for late e-invoice filing, incorrect data fields, issuing paper invoices instead of e-invoices, or accepting VAT without eligible electronic documentation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the Egyptian VAT Law, exports of goods and services are zero-rated if the supplier complies with the documentary evidence requirements of the ETA. For goods, zero-rating requires actual physical export from Egypt evidenced by a customs export declaration discharged by Egyptian Customs. For services, the service must be supplied to a non-resident recipient, used and benefitted from entirely outside Egypt, and not recoverable in Egypt; services directly related to real estate located in Egypt, including leasing or rental of Egyptian property, are not zero-rated and remain subject to VAT at the standard rate where applicable. The zero-rated claim requires full foreign-exchange collection through the banking system and preservation of transport, customs, insurance, and payment documents.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration registered in the Egyptian Customs system and stamped by the discharging customs office
Bill of lading, airway bill, CMR land transport document, or equivalent transport document showing export from Egypt
Inward remittance certificate issued by an Egyptian licensed bank evidencing receipt of export proceeds in freely convertible foreign currency
Commercial invoice, packing list, purchase order or sales contract matching the declared quantities and values
Transportation documents proving the goods left Egypt and arrived at the foreign destination, and any customs declaration at destination (where available)
Certificate of origin (where required by import destination or to secure preferential treatment)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA and Egyptian Customs jointly audit zero-rated transactions. A failed claim, missing export proof, or failure to obtain e-invoice clearance results in immediate reversal of the zero rate and assessment of 14% VAT, late interest, and penalties. Tax evasion penalties under Law No. 67 of 2016 can range up to 50 percent of the due tax plus daily delay interest; false documentation and fraudulent e-invoice registration carry criminal exposure, imprisonment, confiscation of assets, and prohibition from contracting with government entities. Export proceeds not repatriated within the 180-day Central Bank of Egypt period may also trigger foreign exchange violations and loss of tax incentives. The ETA may reassess invoices for up to five years after filing date for incorrect zero-rating, and the taxpayer bears the burden of proving the export through the full documentary chain.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) - Al-Bank al-Markazi al-Masri; the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) exercises supplementary licensing and anti-money-laundering oversight for the real-estate investment vehicle under its capital-market remit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Since the exchange-rate unification of 6 March 2024, the CBE operates a flexible, market-determined EGP/USD regime under the IMF Extended Fund Facility: the Egyptian pound is fully convertible for all current-account transactions, including dividend and profit remittances, with no quantitative ceilings for licensed-bank payments. Capital-account convertibility is conditional on documentation: inbound foreign-direct-investment equity injections must be registered with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) under Law No. 72 of 2017, using the Unified Economic Registration (UER) certificate and the CBE's inward-declaration electronic form. Profit-remittance hurdles are no longer systemic after the clearing of the 2022-2023 FX backlogs, but the distributing vehicle must present audited IFRS financial statements, a board dividend resolution, tax withholding proof (10% dividend WHT under Law No. 91 of 2005, subject to treaty relief), and traceability of the original USD injection through the same authorised dealer bank. The REIT is treated as a non-exporter generating Egyptian-pound rental income; thus current-account convertibility is unrestricted, whereas any future sale of EGP into USD must be based on a genuine underlying distribution or investment-repatriation transaction. Administrative transitory measures, including corporate FX withdrawal caps, remain subject to CBE circulars; treasury policy must monitor CBE dealing-room directives on a daily basis.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Egypt's statutory export regime imposes repatriation, not surrender, of export receipts: 100% of the export value must be credited to the exporter's foreign-currency account at an Egyptian licensed bank within 180 days from the bill-of-lading or airway-bill date unless an extended collection tenor has been approved by the CBE. Mandatory conversion ratio: 0%; the pre-2016 surrender bands (100%/75%/50%) were abolished with the 2016 float, and the March 2024 reform permits free retention of the proceeds in FCY accounts with unrestricted use for current-account payments. The ISIC 6499 REIT does not engage in merchandise export; incidental service receipts, such as property-management fees or administrative recharges collected from non-resident tenants or sponsors, must be characterised in the treasury ledger as non-export service income to avoid triggering the 180-day ranking or the CBE services-repatriation declaration. If the REIT ever sells a stabilised property to a non-resident buyer, the sale proceeds are classified as capital-account FDI disinvestment and are subject to the GAFI repatriation certificate regime rather than the export-proceeds rules.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (USD + EGP)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (USD + EGP)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (USD Distribution)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as the principal treasury rail. The CBE's electronic-money regime (CBE Decree No. 219 of 2017, as superseded by Law No. 194 of 2020 implementing regulations) restricts e-money issuance to licensed Egyptian institutions such as Fawry, Masary and the Meeza network. Offshore digital EMI providers (e.g., Wise, Payoneer, Multitude) hold no Egyptian banking licence, cannot access the EGP ACH or RTGS, and are legally barred from holding the LLC's statutory capital or executing dividend distributions because all foreign-exchange transactions must pass through CBE-licensed authorised dealer banks. Legal constraints: FRA and CBE anti-round-tripping rules require outward dividend flows to be traceable to onshore bank records and to the GAFI-registered capital file. Permitted ancillary use: one offshore EMI account may operate as a low-balance collection node for non-resident subscription proceeds pending a bundle transfer to the Egyptian operational account; the EMI balance must not exceed USD 50,000 overnight and the account must be stripped of payroll, financing and dividend functions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person KYC interview: MANDATORY. Law No. 80 of 2002 (anti-money laundering, as amended by the 2024 amendments adopted under the FATF action plan) and the CBE AML Unit's Customer Due Diligence instructions require all authorised signatories, the beneficial-ownership declarant and the compliance officer of the corporate client to attend a face-to-face interview at the branch. Remote video onboarding is not accepted for Egyptian LLCs. Foreign directors may delegate their attendance via a notarised power of attorney legalised by the Egyptian consulate in the jurisdiction of execution and by the Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Egypt is not a Hague Apostille member); the attorney-in-fact must appear physically and present the original notarised documents. In practice, banks permit a two-step opening: pre-onboarding on scanned documents followed by a 90-day physical confirmation window. The CBE may also require a second interview with the FX dealing desk when the corporate is expected to execute dividend distributions exceeding USD 500,000 per annum.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undisclosed trust or beneficiary layers in the REIT ownership structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full register of beneficial owners (all natural persons with more than 25% economic interest); certified articles of association and the trust deed or SPV registry extract; statement of outstanding units; FRA real-estate fund licensing instrument; notarised UBO declarations for each trustee and beneficiary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection from a non-financial foreign parent without audited accounts or unexplained source of wealth.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 24-month bank statements of the transferor; IFRS audited financial statements of the parent; source-of-wealth memorandum; capital call resolution and share subscription agreement; GAFI clearance certificate under Law No. 72 of 2017; CBE inward-declaration form confirming the investment purpose code.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP status or sanctions-list exposure of a non-resident UBO or contributor.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Current valid passport copies; international sanctions screening report covering OFAC, UN, EU and CBE lists; PEP self-declaration form; compliance sign-off from an Egyptian-regulated counsel; AML Law No. 80 of 2002 reporting and freezing readiness statement submitted to the bank's AML officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspected round-tripping or back-to-back financing circularity between the REIT and the parent.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transaction flow chart with the CBE 'declaration of investment origin'; complete wire trail from the foreign subscription account to the Egyptian escrow account; certification that no related-party EGP liability or mirror deposit exists; auditors' confirmation on the distributable-reserve computation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incomplete Egyptian tax registration or lapsed commercial-registry status.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax card and Unified Economic Registration (UER) report; extract from the Commercial Registry including the latest annual update; prior-year corporate income tax filings and tax clearance receipts; proof of payment of the 10% dividend WHT for any earlier distribution; appointment of a resident tax agent.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Form No. 9) and tax self-assessment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the end of the tax period; 30 April for a 31 December fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late submission attracts administrative monetary penalties under Tax Law No. 91/2005 plus statutory delay interest (currently 18% per annum); continued non-filing for more than 12 months enables ETA to enforce collection and request GAFI to suspend or strike off the company registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited annual financial statements and statutory auditor's report submitted to the ordinary general assembly
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Company Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: General assembly must convene within three months of fiscal year-end; audited statements filed with GAFI within thirty days after approval (for 31 December year-end: GAFI filing by 30 April)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to present audited statements to the general assembly exposes directors to fines under Companies Law No. 187/2023; non-filing for one full reporting cycle blocks the annual commercial-registry renewal, and two consecutive defaults constitute grounds for administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial-registry renewal and data confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the commercial-registration anniversary date; calendar-year registrations renewed no later than 31 January of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: An expired commercial registration impedes new contracts, banking, and customs transactions; incremental late-renewal fines accrue after 30 days, and a lapse exceeding 90 days may trigger adverse action by the Commercial Registry, with cancellation/strike-off after approximately one year of non-renewal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner (UBO) confirmation and updated shareholding register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI - Companies Records and Beneficial Owner Electronic File
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed annually together with the audited financial statements (on or before 30 April for a 31 December fiscal year-end); interim share-transfer filings due within fifteen days of the transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unrecorded share transfers are ineffective against third parties; non-confirmation or false UBO data attracts AML/CFT penalties under the Egyptian Anti-Money Laundering Law (up to EGP 500,000), and unsubstantiated UBO records for two consecutive annual cycles expose the LLC to GAFI administrative file closure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual REIT license-maintenance return and portfolio information statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) - Non-Bank Financial Markets Supervision
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within ninety days of fiscal year-end; license-renewal fee due on or before the annual FRA license anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit the annual FRA return or renew the license suspends the REIT license; unauthorized operation after suspension carries administrative fines and possible FRA referral to GAFI for administrative strike-off/cessation of activities.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Egyptian LLCs under Companies Law No. 187/2023 must appoint a licensed auditor and produce audited annual financial statements; no turnover or asset exemption applies to LLC form, and the FRA additionally requires a registered FRA auditor for licensed REITs. Listed or consolidated REIT structures are subject to independent audit in accordance with FRA/CMA rules.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) as local GAAP; EAS are substantially aligned with IFRS and mandatory for LLCs under Companies Law No. 187/2023 and Tax Law No. 91/2005.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each LLC must maintain a current Register of Members and a Register of Beneficial Owners. Any share transfer must be recorded before it becomes enforceable against the company and third parties; transfers changing direct or indirect ownership of 25% or more must be filed with GAFI's electronic company file within fifteen days. The annual UBO confirmation is delivered with the audited financial statements and certifies that member identities, shareholding percentages, and natural-person beneficial owners are consistent with the filed register; discrepancies discovered during the annual audit must be corrected within fifteen days before GAFI acceptance.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250-USD 850 per annum for a registered office/secretarial agent in Cairo; USD 150-USD 350 per annum in provincial governorates, excluding physical lease costs.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200-USD 5,000 for an LLC REIT holding one to five properties; USD 6,000-USD 15,000 for consolidated SPV or FRA/CMA reporting structures.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No REIT-specific tax holiday. Standard deductions include depreciation on income-generating real property, maintenance and financing costs, and amortization of investment-related expenditures. There is a 0% effective capital gains rate on qualifying Egyptian-listed securities for stock-exchange-registered REIT instruments under specified conditions, but ordinary rental income remains taxed at the 22.5% headline rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return (Form No. 3), filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-filing portal (Isafha)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual return; mandatory quarterly advance tax payments based on estimated taxable profit
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months after the close of the tax year (e.g., by 30 April for a calendar-year taxpayer). The final tax payment must accompany the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the taxpayer, tax card number, and entity registration number in Egypt
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident LLC must insert its Egyptian Tax Card number; if operating through a permanent establishment, include the PE registration identity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting period in Egypt (start date and end date); indicate whether the entity uses the calendar year or a special fiscal year authorized by the ETA
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Set the same tax year as the foreign parent unless a separate Egyptian accounting book period has been pre-approved; attach a note explaining any deviation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross receipts, including rental income from all Egyptian real estate assets, service charges, and other operating income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only Egypt-source income attributable to the PE or statutory entity status. Exclude foreign investment earnings that are not Egypt-sourced.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses: property maintenance, depreciation, management fees, interest on mortgage debt, utilities, insurance, and property taxes
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All deductions must be supported by Egyptian withholding tax certificates or performed by registered local agents. Related-party management fees exceeding an arm's length amount are disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable net profit after deducting allowable expenses, loss utilization, and any preferential deductions, before loss carryforward calculation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If treaty protection is claimed, the net profit must be properly sourced to Egyptian rental activities; a DTA non-discrimination clause does not change the local profit computation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable at the 22.5% headline rate, reduced by the preceding tax years' loss carryforward (maximum five years) and any available foreign tax credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide a schedule of carried forward losses from prior Egyptian tax returns. No loss carryforward is allowed for a foreign head office, only for the Egyptian registered business.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offsets and final settlement: quarterly prepayments, final dividend withholding taxes, and any previous assessment credits; resulting final tax payable or refund claim
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If non-resident shareholders have applied a reduced DTA rate, file the supporting treaty certificate; otherwise the entity must withhold the statutory dividend WHT from distributions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a monthly surcharge of 2% of the assessed tax per month of delay, up to a maximum of 20% of the tax due, plus a fixed fine of up to EGP 500 for administrative failure. Late payment triggers a separate surcharge of 1% per month (or fraction) of the unpaid amount, also capped at 20%. Intentional failure to file may result in criminal fines equal to 50% of the evaded tax, and in egregious cases imprisonment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% (Law No. 91 of 2005, as amended, on outbound dividends to non-resident shareholders not covered by an applicable double taxation agreement).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a reduced dividend WHT rate under an DTA, the non-resident shareholder must attach to the Egyptian Tax Authority a completed treaty relief request (Form 2) together with an original Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the home-country tax authority, certified translation if necessary, and a signed beneficial-ownership declaration. The TRC must prove the shareholder is fiscally resident in a treaty jurisdiction and has no abusive conduit purpose. The relief is applied at source if the ETA pre-approves the reduced rate; alternatively, the excess tax can be recovered via a refund claim within 90 days.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rates for non-resident recipients: royalties 20%; interest 20% (except bank interest taxed at 5% under certain rules). DTA rates commonly reduce interest to 5%–15% and royalties to 10%–20% depending on the counterparty jurisdiction; the ETA requires a TRC and beneficial-ownership evidence to apply these treaty caps.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EGP 15,000,000 aggregate controlled transactions in the fiscal year triggers mandatory Egyptian Local File documentation. The Master File is required when the worldwide group's consolidated revenue exceeds EGP 2,000,000,000.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not have a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations statute. Nevertheless, the General Anti-Avoidance Rules under Article 133 of Law No. 91 of 2005 permit the Egyptian Tax Authority to disregard or recharacterise structures lacking genuine commercial substance. A REIT must maintain a physical office in Egypt, substantiate effective board management and investment decisions, employ qualified local property managers, and keep real estate books in Egypt; otherwise, treaty entitlements can be denied and profits re-allocated to a deemed Egyptian PE.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately under-reporting rental income, overstating acquisition costs, or fabricating maintenance deductions to reduce Egyptian corporate tax liabilities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal conviction: imprisonment for up to 2 years, fine equal to 100% of the evaded tax plus a public penalty of up to 50% of the assessed deficiency; in serious cases the ETA may also impose a monthly late-payment surcharge and administrative fine of up to 100% of the underpaid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for the evaded corporate tax if they signed false returns or directed the falsification. They may face civil restitution of the tax deficiency plus prejudgment interest, a travel ban on leaving Egypt, and personal imprisonment for up to 2 years after final criminal judgment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a mere nominee or conduit with no substantive management, no Egyptian office, and no independent investment decisions, while claiming treaty benefits and passive income exemptions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The GAAR orders recharacterisation of the entity as a domestic PE; all income is taxed at the 22.5% head office rate, treaty relief is denied, and interest on the under-assessed amount accrues from the original filing date. A civil penalty of 40% of the re-allocated tax may be imposed for abusive filings.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced where the directors funnelled payments without commercial substance; directors are jointly liable for the full tax deficiency and face asset freezing orders and a five-year ban from managing any Egyptian entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Setting below-market rent, management fees, or financing terms with a foreign related party so as to shift taxable profit outside Egypt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The ETA makes a primary TP adjustment to an arm's length profit; sloppy documentation leads to a 10% penalty on the overstated deductions. The unpaid amount bears default interest at 1% per month from the original due date, with no cap on the TP adjustment itself.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approved non-arm's-length transactions or submitted false TP documentation are personally liable for the adjusted corporate tax and may be sued for civil damages by minority investors; in aggravated cases, criminal penalties apply for falsified records.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving rent through anonymous cash channels, failing to identify beneficial owners, or remitting dividends abroad without filing the required foreign-exchange declarations with the Central Bank of Egypt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law No. 80 of 2002 (Anti-Money Laundering), fines range from EGP 100,000 to EGP 1,000,000 per violation plus confiscation of the underlying funds. Repeat offenders are exposed to imprisonment up to 5 years, and the entity's trading licence is suspended.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers are criminal employees under the AML law; they face joint and several civil liability for the unreported amounts, a personal travel ban, seizure of personal assets, and imprisonment up to 5 years if money laundering is proven.
